source_title: Gumroad Price Change Is A Huge Disappointment For Thousands Of Builders B6587015B5
snippet_primary: "As a seller in the 3% tier I'm now paying around 750 USD per month in fees. This is going to 3250 USD / month in February. Around 40K a year. I don't know what they're smoking."
subject_exact: Indie Hackers post (December 2022) documents a seller's fee impact from Gumroad's pricing change: from the 3% tier at approximately $750/month fees to $3,250/month (~$40,000/year) after the flat 10% fee takes effect in February 2023
local_qualifiers: Indie Hackers post (Dec 2022): seller at 3% tier (~$750/month) → flat 10% fee ($3,250/month = ~$40K/year) effective February 2023; 4.3x fee increase
parser_notes: indiehackers.com (Dec 2022). English. Gumroad pricing change impact: seller at 3% tier ($750/mo fees) would pay $3,250/mo (~$40K/yr) under flat 10% fee effective February 2023. Documents real-world fee multiplier (4.3x) for a high-volume seller at the lowest previous tier.
